title: Run an initialize preflight recipe before work
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He runs Agentic Recipe `initialize_preflight` so linkage, capability, and checkpoint checks complete before readiness — accepting WalkingLabs L06 guidance. [^wl-l06-init]
implementation: Agentic Recipe `initialize_preflight` via `InitializePreflightTemplate` / `initialize_preflight_runner` and product verb `run_recipe` (`InitializePreflightRecipeAdapter`).
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `initialize_preflight_template.yaml` drives `run_recipe`; expects preflight_ok plus node ids.
